83019: The rival swimmer from Sametsuka Academy. Rin Matsuoka is Haruka's rival who is also in 11th grade. He had gone abroad to study swimming, but his personality changed immensely by the time he had returned to Japan and for this reason he often perplexes his former teammates.
83021: Breaststroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. Haruka's kouhai and a first year. He is a straight-forward person and his actions are faster than his words. He admires Haruka's swimming; it's the reason for him to start swimming.
83023: Freestyle swimmer (crawl) of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. Haruka Nanase is an 11th grader who loves to swim. His strong and quiet swimming style fascinates many, and he holds a strong fixation on freestyle swimming.
83025: A freshman who joins the Iwatobi High School swim team. Rei Ryuugazaki is a classmate of Nagisa's in 10th grade. He was originally a member of the track team, but decided to join the swimming club instead.
83027: Backstroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. Makoto Tachibana is Haruka's inseparable best friend since 11th grade. He understands Haruka's good points, and is often forced to speak as his spokesman.
85949: Rin Matsuoka’s little sister. She's Hazuki's classmate and 1st-year in Iwatobi high school. She has a refreshing personality in school but is always worried about her brother, Rin.
85951: Haruka Nanase and Makoto Tachibana's homeroom teacher and classic literature teacher. She seems to have been an office lady in Tokyo in the past, but no one knows the details. She utters the words of great figures from ages past.
88483: He is the butterfly and freestyle swimmer on Samezuka Academy's swim team and a 3rd year high school student at Samezuka Academy. Sosuke is a close elementary school friend of Rin Matsuoka, and the person who understands him the most.
88486: The captain of the swim team at Sametsuka Academy.
88487: A member of the swim team at Samezuka Academy. He is a first year and Rin Matsuoka's roommate.
88488: Seijuurou's younger brother. He's a first-year student at Samezuka Academy and specializes in swimming the backstroke.
88489: Kisumi Shigino was the first-year junior high student who debuted in the second volume of the light novel High☆Speed! written by Kouji Ouji. Kisumi was the part of the basketball club back at Iwatobi Junior High School.
168918: He's a member of swimming club of Samezuka Academy.
168919: He's one of new members in the Swimming Club of Samezuka Academy.
